lines.text: Jesus passes through Galilee teaching His disciples that men will kill Him and He will rise after seven days.
In the house at Capernaum, the disciples are silent because they had argued about which of them was the greatest.
Jesus says the first must be last of all and servant of all, and takes a child in His arms.
John says they tried to stop a man driving out demons because he was not from Galilee, but Jesus says not to stop him.
Jesus warns that stumbling little ones, sinning hands, feet, and eyes lead to hell, and tells them to have salt and be at peace.
